issue.title: CI/CD: GitHub Pages Deployment Pipeline
issue.body:
## Description
Setup an automated GitHub Actions workflow to build the Vite React application and deploy it to GitHub Pages.

## Tasks
- Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml
- Configure Node and dependencies installation
- Deploy to github-pages environment
